observation.detail: Authored and verified a self-contained local Node procedure at procedures/observation-digest-v1.js (8207 bytes, node builtins fs/path/crypto only) that reads the observations JSON fixture and writes digest.json plus digest.md into the supplied artifacts root, computing row_count, scheduled, completed, incidents, completion_percent (100*completed/scheduled to 2 decimals, 0 when scheduled=0) and per-site totals keyed by site. Feasibility on the real fixture was confirmed by a probe run of a byte-identical copy: row_count 3, scheduled 30, completed 26, incidents 6, completion_percent 86.67, North 81.82, South 100.00; a separate python3 recomputation from the raw bytes matched every total, every site value, the site key set and the input SHA-256. Static review found builtin imports only, no network, shell, child-process or dynamic-eval surface, and no installs. Nine contract cases (wrong arity, relative path, missing file, non-JSON, non-object root, empty observations, negative and non-integer counts) all exited 2 while writing zero output files, and a rerun proved byte-identical digest.json. Probes ran only on an isolated copy writing to sandbox directories; the target was not executed at its qualified path and the qualified output root was left untouched.
